color_story: Warm green-tinted paper with one committed grass-green accent reads as growth and next-season, the quote about tomorrow set on a ground that is already greening; the hue sits at 112 because the mandate's 140-180 target falls entirely inside its own 130-252 forbidden band and within 20 degrees of the recently-shipped 160 and 176 greens, so 112 is the nearest growth-green that clears every avoid zone and maximizes distance from the recent window.
